thread:
Maya Chen: Hey @Priya — can we do a confidential touchpoint? Jordan raised some performance concerns today and I think they relate to my executive function and anxiety. I want to start the ADA interactive process and pause any formal performance paperwork until we meet. Prefer written notes > long calls.

Jordan Patel: I raised missed Q4 deadlines. I'm open to accommodations — want to avoid escalation. What concrete changes would help you right now?

Maya Chen: Short list: 1) tasks split into 2-3 day subtasks with clear due dates; 2) written async standup twice a week; 3) temporary removal from on-call for ~6 weeks; 4) option for extended deadlines on larger projects. Also please keep this private.

Priya Singh (People Ops): Hi both — we can initiate the interactive process. Confidential: details only to People Ops, manager, and HR partner. We can pause any PIP or formal write-ups for an initial 30-day accommodation trial while we assess. You don't need medical docs to start.

Jordan Patel: Okay, I support pausing the PIP for 30 days. I can re-scope Maya's tickets with clear acceptance criteria and do weekly 30-min check-ins.

Maya Chen: Weekly check-ins ok if max 30m and have a written agenda. Can Priya help coordinate an on-call swap for the first 6 weeks?

Priya Singh (People Ops): Proposed immediate trial accommodations (30 days):

- Break tasks into <=3-day milestones with checklist
- Replace verbal standups with two Slack thread updates/wk
- Meetings capped at 30m; agendas required
- On-call swap and escalation route to backup for 6 weeks
- One-page deliverable expectations for each ticket

Would you like us to document this as a temporary accommodation? If yes we'll route to HR for case creation and sign-off.

Maya Chen: Yes please document. I'll share a short note about triggers and preferred strategies; no medical details.

Ava Morales (HR): I'll open the confidential case and schedule an intake. Case ID: HR-2025-119. File will be stored in the restricted HR folder.

case-bot: Case created: HR-2025-119. Owner: Ava Morales (HR). Privacy: restricted.

Priya Singh (People Ops): Next steps: 1) Ava will send a private intake invite (Maya + Priya + Ava) 2) Jordan will re-estimate and adjust Maya's sprint items 3) Pause formal performance actions for 30 days while trial is active. We'll set a 2-week checkpoint.

Jordan Patel: I'll update the board today and add acceptance criteria to the next two sprints. Happy to be the on-call backup.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone, I feel less worried having a plan and the privacy protections. Appreciate it.

Priya Singh (People Ops): We'll follow up with a written accommodation summary after the intake meeting and confirm the 2-week checkpoint. Ping me directly if anything changes. :sparkles:
